integrity: The proof uses the source's Definition 5.7 exactly. IFC forces every relation target to be minimal; FC2 then makes each predecessor fiber a downset, and the converse is direct. The modal formulas are derived from the source's Lemma 5.8 semantics. Exhaustive checks over all labelled posets through four points and all binary relations through three points corroborate the structural equivalence and operator formulas.
scientific_limitations: The count is for labelled IFS relations on a fixed finite poset, not for isomorphism classes. The result does not classify which IFS algebras are isomorphic or which frames arise from the source's prime-filter representation. The minimal-trace factorization applies to the primitive modal operators, not to all Heyting operations.
title: Finite IFS frames are downset families over minimal worlds
